port.description: TCP port smbd listens on. When exposing this block with network.ports[].expose: EXPOSE_VIP, this must differ from the exposed port (445, the one clients connect to) and match target_port instead — the VIP holder's own listen check collides with smbd on whichever node the VIP moves to (always this block's own node, by SINGLETON's design) if the two share a port

shareName.description: The share's network name, as seen in \\host\<shareName>

path.description: Share content directory, relative to the block's mountPath

guestOk.description: Allow unauthenticated (guest) access; mutually exclusive in practice with validUsers

validUsers.description: Space-separated list of the only users allowed to connect (requires those accounts to already have a Samba password set — no user-provisioning story in this phase)

browseable.description: List the share in network browsing
